scaling: StandardScaler mean and population standard deviation, fitted separately on each origin's matured training rows only; constant columns use scale 1. No target scaling.
training: Expanding window. For each 2023 forecast, use 2019-2022 rows plus earlier 2023 rows whose full target has matured strictly before the forecast cutoff. Refit scaling and ridge at each origin for each fixed alpha. Never fit the current or future target.

models.M1: Frozen selected market-history baseline predictions; alpha 0.01.
models.M2: Intercept plus ridge on market history and log1p relevant observed exact-text count.
models.M3: M2 plus threat and disruption shares of all observed candidate exact texts. Shares can overlap; empty weeks retain the frozen zero convention.

selection: Independently select M2 and M3 alpha by smallest pooled 2023 validation MAE, exact ties by larger alpha, using the unchanged five-value baseline grid. Do not expand the grid, change features or replace models after viewing results. Keep M0/M1 frozen.
metrics: MAE primary and RMSE secondary on the identical 52 validation target weeks. Primary comparison M3 minus M2, secondary M2 minus M1, plus all models versus M0. Negative error differences favour the augmented model. Quarter and largest-error diagnostics are descriptive. No confidence interval or significance claim from tuning scores.
final_snapshot: Save safe JSON scalers and regressions for selected M2/M3 alphas on all matured 2019-2023 rows at 2024-01-01T00:00:00+00:00. Later evaluation must refit sequentially with these fixed alphas.
test_policy: Do not parse primary_test.jsonl, financial_rows.jsonl, weekly_ovx.jsonl or raw OVX values in this experiment. Integrity checks may hash existing files. No final-test predictions, metrics or tuning until news specifications and the final evaluation protocol are frozen.
limitations: Validation is used to select regularisation; selected scores are not untouched test estimates.
Observed OVX weekly means and target maturity use the frozen retrospective dataset; exchange-session completeness and actual release times remain unverified.
Adjacent weeks and crisis periods are dependent; comparative accuracy does not establish significance, causality or tradability.
Frozen keyword predictions agree with AI references, with weak disruption recall outside the dominant NLP episode.
FT coverage gaps, shifting source composition and unverified article availability persist; zero shares on empty weeks mean no observed news.
M2/M3 penalties are selected separately on the same validation period; their difference is a model-selection diagnostic, not untouched evidence of incremental information.
feature_diagnostics: Report training-only Pearson correlations and constant features before validation; no outcome-based feature removal or change. Coefficients are predictive parameters, not economic effects.
